about: WP-3.4's ground truth: 30 clips whose phases were labelled from their side-view filmstrips (10 frames, sensors.sheets.filmstrip) and their catalog lines, before describe was written. Phases: stand, walk, run, crouch, sit, lie, air; a clip's phases in order, repeats merged. A verifier reviewed the 30 labels against side sheets and the body's numbers (docs/DECISIONS.md D42): it agreed with 23 and corrected 2 (Death_C is thrown through the air before it lands; Jump_Land starts at its impact, never airborne); 4 were dropped as undecidable under the vocabulary (two in-place jump poses with a leg through the floor, an upright two-knee kneel, a run-up whose flights are within capture's noise) and 3 as near-duplicates of clips kept (the same source motion on the other rig); it labelled 7 replacements, each a different motion, by eye and by numbers.

vocabulary.stand: upright on the feet, not stepping
vocabulary.walk: stepping, a foot always on the floor
vocabulary.run: stepping with both feet off the floor between steps
vocabulary.crouch: low on bent legs, the feet under the body
vocabulary.sit: seated: on a chair (the pelvis behind the feet, thighs level) or on the floor, the trunk upright
vocabulary.lie: the trunk along the floor: lying, crawling
vocabulary.air: off the floor: no foot or hand on it

rules.a: stepping beats height: a crouched or sneaking walk is walk, not crouch
rules.b: one repositioning step is not walk (Sitting_Enter's foot moving 400 mm forward, lifted at most 54 mm)
rules.c: moving into or out of a seat is not crouch (no chair is drawn, so it looks like a squat); a crouch held about 0.25 s counts
rules.d: an opening pose counts only if it is held: Death_C's still start is stand; Jump_Land's first frame, mid-impact, adds nothing
rules.e: kneeling is undefined: a kneel with the feet under the body reads as crouch (Land_Three_Point); an upright kneel isn't used
